trust_decision.summary: The proxy checks once, before sending, that the URL built from the client's path_query has the configured origin. The reqwest client then follows server redirects to other origins (default policy), and that check never sees them.

landing_point.why: The advisory says 'origin limitation bypassed with redirects', and the only origin check is the url.origin() comparison here, a few lines above the Client construction.

fix_sites.entry_point: securedrop-proxy binary: one JSON request on stdin (qrexec service proxy/qubes/securedrop.Proxy; dev mode spawned by app/src/main/proxy.ts:71)
fix_sites.module_kind: main request handler (same function as the check)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only one HTTP client exists in the tree (reqwest in proxy/src/main.rs:6). The Python SDK and the Electron app both go through the proxy binary (app/src/main/proxy.ts:71). No other place follows redirects or builds URLs.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The DISABLE_TOR branch (Client::new(), proxy/src/main.rs:153-154) is labelled dev/testing only, so a solver could set the no-redirect policy on the Tor builder alone. But the project tests run with DISABLE_TOR (proxy/tests/conftest.py:38), so this omission is caught at once.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: 3xx responses must be passed back to the client unchanged (status plus Location header), not turned into errors. An over-broad fix that bails on 3xx breaks the added test test_redirect (fix.diff:53-66). Streaming vs JSON selection for non-4xx/5xx statuses also sits next to the sink.

O6_input_shapes: both client-construction branches: Tor-proxied builder and DISABLE_TOR (fix.diff:27-41)
Proxy::http changed to Proxy::all so https URLs also go through Tor (fix.diff:36-39)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted helper that re-issues the request to a Location or Link header for streamed downloads (e.g. resuming a download), using a new Client without the origin check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Streamed file downloads are a real feature here, and a maintainer could add retry or resume logic. It would still be a WHERE-type sibling in the same file, so low value.

O9_family: open redirect / SSRF-style origin escape through HTTP client redirect following (CWE-601)

O10_build.toolchain: cargo (reqwest 0.12, tokio) plus poetry/pytest with pytest-httpbin
O10_build.project_tests: proxy/tests/test_proxy.py, proxy/tests/test_errors.py via proxy/tests/conftest.py:27-38 (DISABLE_TOR plus local httpbin origin); run with make test in proxy/

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set .redirect(Policy::none()) on the Tor builder only, or re-check the origin of resp.url() after send(). The second still sends the off-origin request.

out_of_scope_notes: Client-supplied headers, including Host, are copied verbatim into the request (proxy/src/main.rs:164-166); not pursued.
Proxy::http at proxy/src/main.rs:158 means https URLs bypass Tor. The same fix commit changes it, but it is a separate anonymity property.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check run); monorepo with client/, app/, export/, log/, proxy/, so probably above 5 MB.
The advisory text itself was not available beyond the summary; the description relies on the fix diff.
Whether reqwest Client::new() picks up system proxy env vars in the DISABLE_TOR path was not checked.
